headline: Nifty edged up while *30 of its 50 stocks fell*
subline: Realty led the tape. Fear fell hard.
hero_text: Smallcaps led. Nifty closed up 0.18% at 25,299.35, behind the broader tape.

why.title: Foreign money came in heavy
why.desc: FIIs bought Rs 7,830.6 Cr in cash while DIIs sold Rs 6,331.17 Cr.

why.title: Bank Nifty beat the index
why.desc: Bank Nifty gained 1.19% against the Nifty's 0.18%.

why.title: Ex dividend hit ONGC and HUL
why.desc: ONGC fell 4.39% and Hindustan Unilever 2.39% as both traded ex dividend.

why.title: Nervousness faded into close
why.desc: India VIX fell 5.34% but still sat in the upper part of its 20 session range.

sector_reasons.Realty: Ran the board as property names rallied
sector_reasons.PSU Bank: State lenders rode the bank rally
sector_reasons.Auto: M&M fell 1.9% and led the drag
sector_reasons.FMCG: HUL and Nestle slipped and weighed
sector_reasons.Oil & Gas: ONGC fell ex dividend and dragged the group

bonus_text: India VIX fell 5.34% to 16.62. Fear eased, yet the gauge still sat in the upper part of its 20 session range.
movers_note_gainers: Financials took every top spot. HDFC Life led at 4.23%.
movers_note_losers: ONGC fell most at 4.39%. ONGC and HUL both traded ex dividend.
watch_text: US PPI data lands at 23:00 IST on Friday, after the close. Nifty max pain sits at 25,200.
lessons: The Nifty and the wider market disagreed. 30 of 50 fell, but gainers still led across NSE.
One sector held the index up. All five top Nifty gainers were financials.
A dividend date pulled two names lower. ONGC and HUL traded ex dividend and fell.
The streak reached ten sessions on a small gain. Bank Nifty did the heavy lifting.
alert_text: US Core PPI and PPI are due tomorrow at 23:00 IST, after Friday's Indian close.
cta_headline: Banks lifted a split tape. *Next bell is Friday*.
cta_sub: Full wrap every evening. US PPI lands at 23:00 IST on Friday.
next_text: Friday 13 November opens with a ten session run on the line. US PPI data lands at 23:00 IST.
